title: Tall white underground facilities and hangars at the north end of Indian Springs Valley
place_text: North end of Indian Springs Valley, Nevada

tellings.quote: Hall claims that the tall whites lived in underground facilities at the north end of Indian Springs Valley, complete with hangers for their craft, a story bearing striking resemblance to that of Bob Lazar.

plain: A man named Charles Hall says that in the 1960s, while he was stationed in the Nevada desert, the "tall whites", tall pale beings he says he met there, lived in underground facilities at the north end of Indian Springs Valley, with hangars for their craft. Michels sums up Hall's claim in his interview with Hall and notes that it closely resembles the story of Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft near Area 51. If true, alien beings would have been living on a US military range.
